title: Item 13 · The five family sign-up pages
subtitle: Approved in each section. The pages families fill in on their phones already share one look: the school's logo, the event card, “Step 1 of 2 · Details”, Continue, then a “Check and send” page (Color Belt, Star, Black Belt: “Send registration” → “[name] is registered”; Camps: “Check and sign” → “Sign up” → “You're signed up”). Forms — the free-class sign-up, also used on the desk tablet — is the different one, and approved that way (v0.235): three short steps with a progress bar, Next, no check page, Submit → “Thanks, Sam!”. (Preview screenshots at phone size, 390 wide · fake data — nothing was sent)

The done pages keep their own words. Pictures 6–7 are the real pages with two words changed; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work; every page was approved. − Forms says “Next” and “Submit” where the others say “Continue” and “Send”.
B · Recommended: the same words, each page keeps its shape (pictures 6–7). Forms says “Continue” and “Send”; everything else stays. + a family who uses two of the pages sees the same words; “Send” is plainer than “Submit”. − two words to change in Forms.
C · Forms gets the same shape as the others: one details page, then “Check and send”. + one shape everywhere. − a longer free-class sign-up on the desk tablet; reopens Forms' approved short steps (v0.235).
